Anchan Emerald

Villa in Pru Jampa (Thep Krasattri, Thalang)
HomeSaleAnchan Emerald

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed villas.

Project overview

Anchan Emerald is the latest villa estate from Pearl Island Property, the developer of the Anchan Villas brand, which has built pool-villa communities in Phuket since 2007. The project is in Pru Jampa (Thep Krasattri), in the green interior of Thalang, and has 44 villas on about 36,800 sqm of land.

All villas have three bedrooms and three bathrooms with a private pool and garden, on plots of roughly 475 to 555 sqm; the main built area is quoted at about 354 sqm, while one agent lists a smaller 264 sqm single-storey layout. The style is modern tropical, with teak and stone finishes. Shared features are a communal garden, parking and 24-hour security; pets are allowed.

The nearest beach, Nai Thon, is about 9 km away, and the airport about 16 minutes by car. The payment plan follows construction stages from a 2% reservation to 10% on handover. Foreign buyers hold the land on a registered lease.
